ADDED TO CALENDAR FOR SEP-03-2021 AT 10:00AM TO CONSIDER ANY ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE BASED ON BREACH OF A WRITTEN CONTRACT. THE COURT'S ORDER ON JUNE 11, 2021 DISMISSING THE CASE DUE TO THE VIOLATION OF STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS BASED ON GROSS NEGLIGENCE, DECEPTIVE AND MISLEADING BEHAVIOR REMAINS IN EFFECT. HOWEVER, THE COURT WILL REOPEN THE CASE TO CONSIDER ANY EVIDENCE BASED ON BREACH OF A WRITTEN CONTRACT, WHICH IS A FOUR (4) YEAR STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FROM THE BREACH. BOTH PARTIES MAY APPEAR VIA ZOOM, WITH PROPER NOTICE REQUIREMENTS. ALL EVIDENCE RELATED TO CONTRACTS BETWEEN THE PARTIES MUST BE SUBMITTED TO THE COURT AND THE OPPOSING PARTY IN ADVANCE OF THE HEARING. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506) HEARING SET FOR SEP-03-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
